settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organization, retention periods and panel users. All on one screen.

org.title: Organization
org.name: Company name
org.nameHint: Shown to candidates exactly as it is typed.
org.mediaRetentionHint: Days a recording is kept after the decision is made.
org.candidateRetentionHint: Days a candidate record is kept after the last contact.
org.purgeNotice: The nightly deletion job is not switched on, so nothing is deleted automatically.
org.readOnlyHint: Only the organization owner can change these.

users.title: Users
users.hint: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}. The role decides what a person can do in the panel.
users.pendingReason: The setup link has not been used yet.
users.readOnlyHint: Only the organization owner can change roles.
users.selfReason: You cannot change your own role or access.
users.lastOwnerReason: This is the only owner. If the role drops, nobody can change the settings.

roleHelp.OWNER: Everything: settings, audit log, export, deletion.
roleHelp.TEACHER: Builds exams, runs the question bank, invites students, grades and finalizes results. No settings, no audit log.
roleHelp.REVIEWER: Scores only. No deletion, no export, no invitations.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Who watched which recording and when is kept here.
audit.noPermission: Only the organization owner can read the audit log.

errors.name: The company name cannot be empty.
errors.retention: Retention has to be between 1 and 3650 days.
errors.self: You cannot make this change on your own account.
errors.lastOwner: The organization has to keep at least one active owner.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every action that touches candidate data lands here. Nothing is deleted, so it still reads months later.
audit.countFiltered: {count} of {total, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
audit.subjectFilter: Show the history of this record

empty.title: No audit entries yet.
empty.hint: A row lands here when a recording is watched, a decision is written or a link is minted.

zero.title: No entry matches these filters.
zero.hint: {count, plural, one {# filter is on} other {# filters are on}}.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to the audit log.
noAccess.hint: Only the organization owner can open this screen.

userInvite.title: Invite a user
userInvite.subtitle: You open the account; the person sets their own password.
userInvite.name: Full name
userInvite.noEmailSent: No email is sent. You pass the link on yourself.
userInvite.reinviteHint: Inviting the same address again cancels the older link.
userInvite.readyReissued: A new link for {name} is ready. The old one is dead.
userInvite.readyHint: This link will not be shown again. Copy it now.
userInvite.noAccessHint: Only the organization owner can open this screen.

userInviteErrors.NAME_REQUIRED: The full name cannot be empty.
userInviteErrors.EMAIL_TAKEN: That email already belongs to an account.

setup.title: Set your password
setup.subtitle: Your account is open on {email}. Set a password to enter the panel.
setup.invalidHint: It may be used or expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
setup.invalidBack: Go to the sign in screen

setupErrors.TOO_SHORT: The password has to be at least {min} characters.
setupErrors.MISMATCH: The two passwords do not match.
setupErrors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link is no longer valid.
